answers.assumption_check: Two assumptions carry load. (1) Every caller that starts a unit for a test run passes CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID in env=: measured, superclaude.py builds mark from env and hands it to service_spawn for both the ground loop and the web unit (superclaude.py:464-481), and it is the only caller outside proofs (grep service_spawn under cairn/ and bin/). (2) CollectMode is accepted by systemd-run -p on this systemd: the shell passed it there for months (ef541167c:cairn/devices/cc/superclaude:624), and set-property refusing it after start was measured 2026-11-23. Neither is left implicit.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs: the exact line (in service_spawn's systemd branch, extend cmd with ['-p', 'CollectMode=inactive-or-failed'] when (env or {}).get('CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID')); that the reset-failed retry reuses cmd and so carries it too; the proof's argv (sys.executable -c 'import sys; sys.exit(3)'), unit names cairn-proof-collect-<pid>-<n>, a 10s poll of systemctl --user show -p LoadState, and a finally that stops and reset-fails both units; and that the proof must not run under a test id it inherits for clause 2, so it strips CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID from the env it passes. All of this is in the ticket's decisions.

answers.collision_check: Tickets d50d162c5428 and f04d5ef26a48 want a test run's units collected; outside a run the manager's default CollectMode is kept (f04d5ef26a48's tooth 4), and clause 2 holds that. The launch charter's why (every OS answer in the system device, RULE 1) is served: the property rides the one door that starts units instead of a second spawner in superclaude.py. No collision.
answers.falsifier_check: Clause 1: with CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID in env, a unit whose argv exits non-zero is gone (LoadState not-found) within 10s. Clause 2: with no test id, the same failing unit stays loaded with ActiveState failed (the proof then reset-fails it). Horizon: this proof, red-first on main (clause 1 red, clause 2 green), green after the build; then e179281f6eff's test_a_failed_unit_of_a_run_collects_itself reads green.
